arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Kneedler argued these aliens lack entry documents and rights.
Gelernt argued the statute eliminates meaningful judicial review.
Sotomayor noted asylum seekers have a statutory right to stay.
Kagan asked if the hearing adequately determines asylum eligibility.
